key: What does a factory like this produce, anyway...? Other than waste...
en: What does a factory like this produce, anyway...?  Other than waste...
ja: そもそも、こういう工場って何を作ってるんだろう……? 廃棄物以外に……

key: I used to love to stare out at the lake, for hours on- *cough* *cough*
en: I used to love to stare out at the lake, for hours on- *cough* *cough*
ja: 昔は何時間も湖を眺めるのが好きだったんだ――*ゴホッ* *ゴホッ*

key: ...I should get back inside... The air quality is too low out here for me... Maybe just a little longer...
en: ...I should get back inside... The air quality is too low out here for me... Maybe just a little longer...
ja: ……そろそろ中に戻らないと……ここは空気が悪すぎる……もう少しだけ……

key: 'Ey yooo. Wit' da- fuzzlin' and the *hic*. C'mere!
en: 'Ey yooo. Wit' da- fuzzlin' and the *hic*. C'mere!
ja: よぉーう。あのフワフワしたのと*ヒック*。こっち来いよ!

key: ...What'll bots a hunger fluff...?
en: ...What'll bots a hunger fluff...?
ja: ……なんかフワフワの飢えたやつは……?

key: Hummanah... wha?
en: Hummanah... wha?
ja: ふぬぬ……なんだって?

key: Represent!
en: Represent!
ja: レペゼン!

key: That don't represent nothin'...
en: That don't represent nothin'...
ja: それ、何のレペゼンにもなってねえ……

key: You gotta carry yourself, you gots to wear the swag, homes.
en: You gotta carry yourself, you gots to wear the swag, homes.
ja: 自分を貫かなきゃな、スワッグを身にまとわねえと、相棒。

key: Ugh, where are they?
en: Ugh, where are they?
ja: うーん、どこにいるんだ?

key: They said to meet at the old factory...
en: They said to meet at the old factory...
ja: 古い工場で待ち合わせって言ってたのに……

key: Maybe they meant the other factory! It's their fault for not specifying. How careless of them!
en: Maybe they meant the other factory! It's their fault for not specifying. How careless of them!
ja: もしかしてもう一つの工場のことだったのかも! ちゃんと指定しなかったあいつらが悪い。不注意にもほどがある!

key: Hm?
en: Hm?
ja: ん?

key: Hey, what are you looking at?
en: Hey, what are you looking at?
ja: おい、何見てんだよ?

key: Got a problem? I hope not. You don't quite know who you're messing with.
en: Got a problem? I hope not. You don't quite know who you're messing with.
ja: 文句あるのか? ないといいけどな。お前、誰に関わってるか分かってねえみたいだ。

key: Name's Fern. I'm the cool cat, and the top dog. Got it?
en: Name's Fern. I'm the cool cat, and the top dog. Got it?
ja: 名前はファーン。クールな野郎で、トップの座にいる男だ。覚えたか?

key: No, no... I don't think you do.
en: No, no... I don't think you do.
ja: いや、いや……分かってねえみたいだな。

key: You know what, get ready for a lesson in class!
en: You know what, get ready for a lesson in class!
ja: よし、クラスのお勉強の時間の準備でもしとけ!

key: Hah! Way to get lucky.
en: Hah! Way to get lucky.
ja: はっ! 運がよかっただけだろ

key: Whatever, man. Don't have time for this.
en: Whatever, man. Don't have time for this.
ja: もういいわ。こんなのに構ってる時間ねえ。

key: Unlike you, I have places to be, and people waiting for me.
en: Unlike you, I have places to be, and people waiting for me.
ja: お前と違って、オレには行くとこがあるし、待ってる奴もいるんだよ。

key: So what if you're doing the Gym League challenge? And you don't even have a badge yet? Talk about lame.
en: So what if you're doing the Gym League challenge?  And you don't even have a badge yet? Talk about lame.
ja: ジムリーグ挑戦してるからってどうした? しかもバッジまだ一個も持ってねえのか? しょぼすぎだろ。

key: Maybe you should go work on that. I, on the other hand, am required elsewhere.
en: Maybe you should go work on that. I, on the other hand, am required elsewhere.
ja: それより先にそっち頑張ったらどうだ。オレの方は、他で必要とされてるんでな。

key: Later, loser!
en: Later, loser!
ja: じゃあな、負け犬!

key: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff! Ruff! Ruff! Ruff! Ruff!
en: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff! Ruff! Ruff! Ruff! Ruff!
ja: ヨーテリー: ワン! ワン! ワン! ワン! ワン! ワン!

key: Lillipup ran away again!
en: Lillipup ran away again!
ja: ヨーテリーはまた逃げ出した!

key: AMARIA: Great, you're here! Okay, so now we need to figure out a way into this place...
en: AMARIA: Great, you're here! Okay, so now we need to figure out a way into this place...
ja: アマリア: よかった、来たね! よし、それじゃここへの入り方を考えないと……

key: AMARIA: Hm...
en: AMARIA: Hm...
ja: アマリア: うーん……

key: AMARIA: Okay... I think this'll work...
en: AMARIA: Okay... I think this'll work...
ja: アマリア: よし……これでいけると思う……

key: Deliverance, I need you!
en: Deliverance, I need you!
ja: デリバランス、お前が必要よ!

key: AMARIA: Okay, Deliverance. Use Waterfall, and then Ice Beam!
en: AMARIA: Okay, Deliverance. Use Waterfall, and then Ice Beam!
ja: アマリア: よし、デリバランス。「たきのぼり」、それから「れいとうビーム」!

key: AMARIA: ...Perfect! I can always count on you, Deliverance~
en: AMARIA: ...Perfect! I can always count on you, Deliverance~
ja: アマリア: ……完璧! いつも頼りにしてるよ、デリバランス~

key: Now, return!
en: Now, return!
ja: さあ、戻って!

key: AMARIA: Shall we?
en: AMARIA: Shall we?
ja: アマリア: 行きましょうか?

key: TEDDIURSA: Ursa!
en: TEDDIURSA: Ursa!
ja: ヒメグマ: ウーサ!

key: Teddiursa fled!
en: Teddiursa fled!
ja: ヒメグマは逃げ出した!

en: <>- Blacksteam Street\n^ - Crystal Street
ja: <>- ブラックスチーム通り\n^ - クリスタル通り

en: >- Cinderton Street\nv - Crystal Street
ja: >- シンダートン通り\nv - クリスタル通り

key: Hello, trainer!
en: Hello, trainer!
ja: こんにちは、トレーナーさん!

key: Can I interest you in buying a pack of Pokesnax?
en: Can I interest you in buying a pack of Pokesnax?
ja: ポケスナックの詰め合わせ、いかがですか?

key: Pokesnax are a delicious treat for your Pokémon! Feeding your Pokémon Pokesnax will make them that much happier!
en: Pokesnax are a delicious treat for your Pokémon!  Feeding your Pokémon Pokesnax will make them that much happier!
ja: ポケスナックは、ポケモンにとって美味しいおやつです! あげれば、ポケモンはもっと幸せになりますよ!

key: But that's not at all!
en: But that's not at all!
ja: でも、それだけじゃないんです!

key: Just by having these delicious, nutritious sweet treats to eat, rare wild Pokémon will be more likely to approach you!
en: Just by having these delicious, nutritious sweet treats to eat, rare wild Pokémon will be more likely to approach you!
ja: この美味しくて栄養満点な甘いおやつを持っているだけで、珍しい野生のポケモンが近づいてきやすくなるんですよ!

key: Nawwwh, I don't mean random encounters in the grass- who would want that?
en: Nawwwh, I don't mean random encounters in the grass- who would want that?
ja: いやいや、草むらでのランダムエンカウントの話じゃないですよ――そんなの誰が欲しいですか?

key: I mean on special occasions other Pokémon may approach you that wouldn't normally. So what to do you say?
en: I mean on special occasions other Pokémon may approach you that wouldn't normally. So what to do you say?
ja: 特別な機会には、普段は近づいてこないようなポケモンが近づいてくるかもしれない、って話です。いかがですか?

key: Care to buy up some Snax?
en: Care to buy up some Snax?
ja: スナックを買っていきませんか?
